description: PF8 paging forward from page 1 to page 2 over the twenty-five-record file: the WHEN DFHPF8 arm at app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:130-131 into PROCESS-PF8-KEY at :260-277. This is a re-entry, so :115 fails, :121 RECEIVEs the map and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :122-137 selects PF8. :117's MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR0AO belongs to the first-entry branch and is NOT on this path, which is why every blank cell here is a SPACE rather than a LOW-VALUE: INITIALIZE-USER-DATA at :293-295 writes SPACES to all ten rows before the fill, and SEL0001O through SEL0010O each carry a single space for exactly that reason (practice B8 - the LOW-VALUES-versus-space distinction is load-bearing, and this case sits on the space side of it). CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST arrives as USER0005, so :262's test fails and the ELSE at :265 anchors the browse on that key: this is the folder's ONLY coverage of that arm, and case10 covers its :263 HIGH-VALUES sibling, so the pair is complete. NEXT-PAGE-YES arrives 'Y' so :270 holds and :271 pages forward, where case09 covers the ELSE at :272-277. STARTBR at :284 reports NORMAL, and the test at :288 is COBOL's abbreviated combined relation - EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3 expands to NOT EQUAL to each of the three - so it holds for PF8 and the READNEXT at :289 discards the anchor record page 1 already displayed. Reading that relation as an OR would keep USER0005 and shift the whole page by one record. The loop at :300-306 then reads ZUSER001 through ZUSER010 into rows 1 to 10, ascending because :304 adds to WS-IDX; :308 finds the file not at end, so :309-310 counts the page to 2 and the look-ahead READNEXT at :311 finds ZUSER011, which keeps NEXT-PAGE-YES set at :313 (gate G28 - this is the FULL-page increment, distinct from the short-page one at :320-321 that case03 and case18 reach and that case04 must not). ENDBR fires at :325, as it does on every path that gets past :286, then :327 moves the page number to PAGENUMI - the same storage as PAGENUMO, because COUSR0AO REDEFINES COUSR0AI - and :328 moves SPACE to USRIDINO, which is why USRIDINO is eight spaces here. POPULATE-USER-DATA's WHEN 1 and WHEN 10 arms carry second receivers at :388-389 and :434-435, so CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST becomes ZUSER001 and CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST becomes ZUSER010 - the one-based subscript of 02 USER-REC OCCURS 10 TIMES at :57, which is the top off-by-one risk in the migration (gate G33). WS-MESSAGE was set to SPACES at :105 and is never reassigned on this path, so ERRMSGO is seventy-eight spaces, no error flag is raised, and none of the three DISPLAY sites at :608, :642 and :676 is reached. EXACTLY ONE TRANSMISSION: the send at :329 is the only one this path performs - :119 belongs to the first-entry branch - and it is also the only one the handler publishes, so the single entry in sends pins all fifty-nine DFHMDF fields of what the terminal is left displaying. expectedReturnCode is 0, and holds for all twenty cases: the program contains no MOVE ... TO RETURN-CODE and no CALL 'CEE3ABD', and every path ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CU00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) of :141-144. GATE G47 - THE I/O OUTCOMES THIS CASE COVERS, AND THE ONES IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT: here STARTBR reports NORMAL and READNEXT reports NORMAL twelve times, which is the busiest all-NORMAL path in the folder. STARTBR's WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm at :600-606 is case04's; READNEXT's WHEN DFHRESP(ENDFILE) arm at :634-640 is case03's and case18's; READPREV's WHEN OTHER at :675-681 is case17's; and STARTBR's WHEN OTHER at :607-613 - the arm that DISPLAYs RESP and REAS, raises WS-ERR-FLG, paints 'Unable to lookup User...' and then makes :286 refuse the rest of the paragraph so that ENDBR never fires - is case19's, which reaches it by forcing the start-browse outcome because no shape of seeded data can express a file that exists and cannot be reached. Each of those arms is covered once and is not duplicated here: this case is the one that proves the :265 anchor and the :309-310 full-page increment, and a second copy of an arm another case already owns would have cost the folder that coverage. STATELESSNESS (gate G37, rule R6): the anchor, the page number and the next-page flag all arrive in the payload and all leave in it - CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST comes in as USER0005 and goes out as ZUSER010, CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM comes in as 1 and goes out as 2 - and nothing is retained between calls, which is why this is one of the three cases the gate re-runs twice over a single controller and compares the two answers. Gate G38: this is the RE-ENTRY side of the ENTER-versus-REENTER pair, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arriving 1 and leaving 1, where case02 is the first-entry side. NO ATTRIBUTE ITEM IS DECLARED, because the program moves none: COUSR00C copies COCOM01Y, COUSR00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA and NOT CSSETATY or DFHATTR, it validates no individual field, and ERRMSG is STATICALLY COLOR=RED ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) LENGTH=78 at app/bms/COUSR00.bms:449-452 - inventing a runtime DFHRED move or a '*' overwrite would be a new behaviour (practice B5). Page size ten is BEHAVIOUR, not configuration (gate G39): it is hard-coded at :293, :300, :347 and :352 and by the OCCURS 10 at :57, the ten rows fill exactly while records eleven through twenty-five exist and are deliberately not shown, and no page-size value appears anywhere in this file. USRSEC is addressed by its binding key throughout and never by a dataset name (gate G46). mapFields is declared EMPTY on purpose rather than omitted for brevity: :121's RECEIVE does execute, but the PF8 arm reads only EIBAID and the communication area, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :149-232 is not performed, and so no SEL000nI and no USRIDINI is ever examined on this path. SEED (twenty-five rows, inline): USRSEC has no ASCII fixture - app/data/ASCII holds nine and none of them is a security-user file - so its rows are always inline and no tenth fixture is requested. Rows one to ten are VERBATIM in-stream records of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 at their in-stream width of exactly 57 characters and are byte-identical to case01.json's seed; the fifteen ZUSER001 through ZUSER015 rows are SYNTHESIZED in the identical X(08) plus X(20) plus X(20) plus X(08) plus X(01) layout, and their keys sort after both ADMIN and USER so that the ten-row page boundary can be crossed at all. No row is pre-padded: the twenty-three-byte shortfall is the absent SEC-USR-FILLER, and it is carried to 80 once, at seed time, by the single USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation declared below, whose sole owner is ParityCase.DatasetNormalisation.normaliseSeedRow, which ParityHarness calls. SEC-USR-PWD stays the plaintext eight-character literal the legacy design stores and compares at app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:223, IF SEC-USR-PWD = WS-USER-PWD (practice B6) - hashing, masking or omitting it would change what this contract asserts. WIDTHS, SUMMED MECHANICALLY FROM THE COPYBOOKS (practice B11): app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 gives SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48 and SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56, which is 8+20+20+8+1 = 57, and the NAMED SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57 makes 80 - the same 80 that app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:48 declares as DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) and that its IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER at :64-66 fixes independently as RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0). SEC-USR-FILLER is an ordinary named item and not an anonymous FILLER, so it is named in every field map below and asserted as twenty-three spaces (gates G19 and G21 - a record that omitted it would be twenty-three bytes short, and the whole-image assertion beside the field map says so immediately). app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 sums 4+8+4+8+8+1+1+9+25+25+25+11+1+16+7+7 = 160, and the six spans of CDEMO-CU00-INFO at :67-75 add 8+8+8+1+1+8 = 34, which is why eibcalen is 194: the extension travels in the payload and is NOT a member of the shared 160-byte NavigationContext. COTRN00C's equivalent extension is 58 bytes, and copying an expectation from that structural twin is the one mistake this width would hide. Screen field lengths come from the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY - TRNNAME 4, TITLE01 and TITLE02 40, CURDATE, CURTIME, PAGENUM and USRIDIN 8, then ten rows of SEL 1, USRID 8, FNAME 20, LNAME 20 and UTYPE 1, then ERRMSG 78, which is 8 + 50 + 1 = 59 fields - while the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items stay metadata and never become payload. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:34, which is the source's own version stamp at :694 rather than an invented instant, because POPULATE-HEADER-INFO calls FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at :564 on every send and an unpinned header would make this case irreproducible; CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are its 07/19/22 and 23:12:34 renderings through :571-581. The code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and never defaulted. RULE R1: the plan mandates the class name UserMenuController, but the Function header at app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:5 reads 'List all users from USRSEC file', app/bms/COUSR00.bms:79 paints INITIAL='List Users' and README.md:228 records CU00 the same way. The name comes from the plan and the behaviour from the source: this is a paginated list screen, and nothing here expects menu-shaped behaviour. PROVENANCE (practice B12, risk R-A): every expected value here was DERIVED BY STRUCTURED READING of the COBOL and its copybooks and was NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy program - executing it is impossible in this environment, which has no z/OS or CICS runtime, whose COBOL compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, and which is missing the IBM-supplied DFHAID and DFHBMSCA. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-of-zero gate are all preserved. The derivation rests on app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:40-57, :66-76, :98-144, :257-277, :282-331, :384-441, :446-501, :522-544 and :586-614; app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23; app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44; app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, whose CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 are the two forty-character literals reproduced byte for byte; the fifty-nine xxxI items of app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY; app/bms/COUSR00.bms, whose PAGENUM is LENGTH=8 COLOR=BLUE at POS=(4,71) and whose ERRMSG is LENGTH=78 COLOR=RED at POS=(23,1); app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, :48 and :64-66; and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:88-99 and :449-453, which define FILE(USRSEC) with ADD, BROWSE, DELETE, READ and UPDATE and TRANSACTION(CU00) over PROGRAM(COUSR00C). This program uses browse alone, which is why expectedWrites is empty and expectedDatasets asserts twenty-five unchanged rows at eighty bytes.
